You pick up the replenishment slip, safely drive the reach truck to the bulk location, and ensure everything is moved neatly and without damage. As a Reach Truck Driver, you work in a dynamic warehouse environment where accuracy, speed, and safety come together. Do you have reach truck experience and a valid Dutch certificate? Then this is a great opportunity for you.

 What will you do? 
As a reach truck driver, you will have varied tasks in the warehouse. You will work with pallets of both large and small items and will regularly handle fragile products. Therefore, it is important that you work carefully and always prioritize safety. 
You pick up goods based on replenishment receipts, move them with the reach truck from bulk locations, and put them back in their correct place. Additionally, you pick orders from full pallets and check if everything is correct before the goods move further in the process. Your efforts keep the warehouse organized and allow colleagues to proceed quickly with their work. 
You work a two-shift system with times of 6:00 AM - 3:00 PM or 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM.
